name: Verify chat input is accessible with virtual keyboard on mobile
objective: Validate input remains visible when keyboard is up
precondition: User logged in on mobile viewport, chat open

steps.description: Set the browser viewport to mobile dimensions
steps.expectedResult: Viewport is set to mobile size

steps.description: Focus on the chat input field (simulating virtual keyboard appearance)
Verify the input field is not hidden behind the virtual keyboard
steps.expectedResult: Chat input remains visible and accessible even when virtual keyboard is displayed
